description: Get the ClinicalTrials.gov trials Signal8 has matched to a company: phase, status, conditions, interventions and key dates. IMPORTANT, sponsor role: the list includes trials the company LEADS and trials where it is only a COLLABORATOR on another organisation's study. Each trial carries metadata.sponsorRole ("lead" | "collaborator" | null = not determined) and metadata.sponsor (the lead sponsor). Only lead trials are the company's own pipeline; describe a collaborator trial as "a <lead sponsor> trial the company collaborates on", never as the company's own. Pass sponsorRole="lead" to get only those. The response's total / leadTotal / collaboratorTotal count the full list, so compare total with the returned count to see whether it was truncated. Dates of type ESTIMATED are sponsor projections, not facts.

limit.description: Maximum number of clinical trials to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

sponsorRole.description: Filter by the company's role: "lead" (its own trials), "collaborator", or "all" (default).

name: get_clinical_trials
